type Client = { send(value: number): Promise<void> };
export async function sendItems(items: number[], width: number, connect: () => Promise<Client>) {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      await (await connect()).send(items[index]!);
    }
  }));
}
